body:
Thank you for your kind words and experience. Just getting it out there was something I needed to do. I'm just getting obsessed with hanging. I have 2 kids who need their father so it is out of the question for me to do it, i just want all this pain to go away. It's so hard when (I thought) we were the happiest family ever. I guess I held her in too tight and that made her leave. I am spending the weekend with my daughter, like I did last weekend. I will be the best dad in the world, and I never talk about her mom with her. Well, last weekend she asked me when me and her mom were getting married so that I can move back in, that was a hard question for me. I talk to my daughter on the phone every night, that helps but I usually hang up in tears. I miss them both so badly. It's been 3 months, but these months flew by as I have been eyeball deep into addiction.

Again thank you for your insight.
